game_title: Patrol Decision Tree – Merchant Wharf Defense
game_concept: A action defense set in Coastal Port – Merchant Wharf, the merchant wharf: the sailor must handle storm gulls while practicing conditionals (if / elif / else). Core idea – Patrol Decision Tree: Program a guard-evasion decision tree using nested conditions.
theme: Coastal Port – Merchant Wharf: the merchant wharf
core_gameplay_loop: In Merchant Wharf, repeat each round: Program a guard-evasion decision tree using nested conditions. Each round, storm gulls strike the signal flag, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the cover value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Protect the signal flag from storm gulls in Merchant Wharf: keep the cover meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 42-second timer ends.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
lose_condition: cover drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 42-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 3 – Conditionals (if / elif / else) | Level 5 (applied tier): Patrol Decision Tree
assets_style: pixel-art harbor town: deep blue sea, wooden docks, orange-roofed buildings, sailing ships; flat Kenney-style sprites; sea-shanty accordion with wave and gull ambience
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Patrol Decision Tree' (Week 3 slot 15), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Merchant Wharf'. tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how cover changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against storm gulls in Merchant Wharf.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 42 seconds while cover > 0.
